We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. No SMILES given. We need to retrieve data? Possibly need to get IR spectra to see carbonyl peaks? Or carbon NMR? But easiest is to get the structure. Maybe the system has a sample "at hand". Use carbon_nmr_spectra? But we need to know carbonyl count. Could use IR spectra to detect C=O stretch around 1700 cm-1. But need count. Could also use carbon NMR: carbonyl carbons appear ~190-220 ppm. Count peaks there.

Thus we need to retrieve carbon NMR spectra. Use function carbon_nmr_spectra.
